atelier.description: Handcrafted cutting boards for your kitchen island: oak, walnut, end grain and made-to-measure pieces, chosen with personal advice from our workshop.
texts: Cutting boards for open-plan kitchens and islands
One-off pieces and made-to-measure boards chosen for your worktop, space and everyday use.
Visit our workshop by appointment and choose your wood with us, subject to availability.
We discuss the details by phone and, if you wish, show you your board in photos or a video before collection or dispatch.
Enquire about a board for my kitchen
Individual pieces for kitchens where wood deserves to be seen.

Edle Hölzer Atelier is our approach to choosing and making a board for its future home. For open-plan kitchens, islands, light interiors, dark cabinetry or entertaining, the grain, weight, edge, thickness and intended use need to work together.
Enquire about a board for your kitchen or island
Your board starts with an idea.

How would you like to use it? A rough idea is enough. We will work out the dimensions, wood and details together. Our first reply gives you an initial view of feasibility, price range and production time.
You can email us a kitchen photo later. You do not need one for your first enquiry.

Five routes to a board that becomes part of your kitchen.

This page does not show everything we make. It brings together pieces and projects where wood selection, appearance and the setting matter most: a considered kitchen, an island, an open-plan interior, a special gift or a carefully planned custom piece. Atelier is our name for this curated process.
Dark, understated wood for light kitchens, charcoal cabinetry, islands and entertaining.
Working boards for open worktops where weight, stability and substance are part of the appeal.
Distinctive patterns and wood combinations for a board that becomes a deliberate part of the room.
Historic wood, numbered individual pieces and production guided by the available material.
Made to measure for kitchen islands
Choose the format, edge, juice groove, engraving and grain to suit how you use it.
Not always available. Never repeatable. Only when the wood allows it.

The Erbstück collection brings together boards made from exceptional timber, wood with a history and rare material combinations. We assess each piece individually and make it only when appearance, stability and intended use belong together.
Why a board for a kitchen island needs a different approach

A board in an open kitchen does more than cut. It stays in view: on an island, beside natural stone, in a bright kitchen, against dark cabinetry or where guests can see you work. Before choosing, we consider not just wood and price but format, weight, grip, surface, edge and future care.

Some kitchens call for an understated walnut board. Others suit a substantial end-grain board, a 3D pattern or an Erbstück made from historic timber. Not every striking piece suits every room. That is where our advice begins.
The price of a good board is not explained by calling it premium. It makes sense when you can see the material, construction and service behind it.
Understated or distinctive grain is chosen to suit the format.
Thickness and weight should suit its place: easy to move, permanently on the worktop or used as a chopping block.
Edges, grip recesses, juice grooves and engraving are recommended only when they make sense.
Care and later refurbishment are part of the product's life.
Which kitchens is this selection for?

For people who want to shape their kitchen thoughtfully: contemporary interiors, kitchen islands, open-plan spaces, marble worktops, dark or light cabinetry, entertaining areas and architect-designed homes. And for gifts that feel truly considered.

Sometimes a cutting board is just the beginning. On request, we can explore whether the same or a complementary wood could also become a dining tabletop, coffee tabletop or another piece for your living and kitchen space.
A board, island and tabletop can be considered together so the wood tones and overall effect work in harmony.
We make the top. You can provide the legs, or we can discuss suitable options together.
Unusual woods need lead time: suitable boards must be sourced, checked and prepared.
The aim is a considered material palette for your kitchen, table and daily life, rather than an isolated purchase.
Briefly describe how you want to use it. Dimensions or a kitchen photo can follow later.
We discuss wood, construction, details, price and production time. You do not need to know everything in advance.
We produce the agreed design and arrange delivery or collection.
Service that starts before the board

We want you to know what to expect from a board in this selection. We show you the material, dimensions and details so you can look forward to the finished piece. For available one-offs, we are happy to answer short questions on WhatsApp. Custom projects start with a brief enquiry. We then record the agreed dimensions, materials and details together.

Our aim is a process that matches the care put into the piece: personal, calm and clear. Tell us freely what size or effect you have in mind. We explain what makes technical sense, which woods are available and when a special board will need more time.
Wood products for restaurants & hotels (Germany, DE)
A few things to consider before choosing.
How is a board for an open kitchen different from a standard cutting board?

It is considered as a visible part of the room: an open kitchen, island, contemporary interior or entertaining space. Grain, construction, thickness, weight, edge and intended use are chosen together. Edle Hölzer Atelier is our selection and custom-making process for that.
Can I choose the wood and format?

You can share your preferences, but not every format makes sense in every wood. Bring your kitchen plans, worktop dimensions or the effect you want, and we will assess size, thickness, construction and available material for your space.
Why do some boards cost considerably more?
Price differences come from material, thickness, construction, size, work involved, wood selection and details such as a juice groove, engraving or special edges.
Are these boards for daily use or just serving?
They are made to be used and seen: in the kitchen, on an island, when entertaining, at the barbecue or for serving. What matters is that the particular board suits its purpose.
A board that becomes part of your kitchen.
Explore available individual pieces or enquire about a board for your kitchen, island or architect-designed home when setting, grain, engraving and format should feel right together.

corporate-gifts.title: Handcrafted wooden corporate gifts
corporate-gifts.description: Personal wooden corporate gifts from our workshop: cutting boards, serving boards and kitchen utensils with engraving, chosen for your quantity, budget and occasion.
texts: Handcrafted wooden products for your business
With your logo, as a coordinated gift set or made to your own idea. Explore cutting boards, serving boards, kitchen utensils and gift sets for employees, customers, business partners and events.
We choose products, woods, combinations and possible engraving with your business in mind. We check quantities, availability and your preferred date before preparing an offer.
Choose your products. Find the right combination.
Individual products, combined sets or your own idea: we tailor the selection to your occasion, quantity and budget. The images show products and possible combinations from our range.
Individually made in solid wood, in different formats, with or without engraving. For employees, customers and business partners.
Spatulas, dough scrapers and butter knives can be combined in different ways. We discuss suitable woods and possible engraving for your selection.
For example, a breakfast board with a butter knife, or a cutting board with care balm. We agree the combination and possible packaging in your offer.
Wooden business cards with your contact details or logo. We discuss the design, format and technical feasibility in advance.
From our workshop in central Hesse. Grain and colour make each piece of wood unique.
Depending on the product, we can engrave your mark, names or a message. We agree the design and legibility in advance.
Regional timber, such as oak, is available on request. We discuss the species and origin to suit the product and available material.
Sets for your occasion and budget
Boards, kitchen utensils and care products can be combined. You do not have to choose a predefined set.
Depending on the product, design and quantity, volume discounts may be possible. Your offer sets out the specific terms.
We discuss your idea personally and clarify feasibility, price and timing before making it. Your own product ideas are welcome too.
We combine existing products and explore suitable woods, names, messages or a logo engraving. Whether a short lead time is possible depends on availability, quantity and the changes required.
Looking for a special format or your own wooden product? Send us a description or sketch. We assess how it can be made and discuss the design, work involved and timing.
Looking for wooden products for a restaurant or hotel?
Price depends on the product, wood, quantity, engraving and combination. These approximate examples help you plan; we calculate sets and custom projects individually.
Medium boards · up to approx. 40 × 30 cm
Dimensions and designs are examples, not fixed size categories. These price ranges are not a binding offer. Engraving, packaging, shipping and tax details are clarified in your specific offer.
Standard products generally start at 10 pieces. For more customised projects, a sensible starting quantity is usually 25 pieces. We discuss your requested quantity and date together.
What do an enquiry and individual planning cost?

Your enquiry and an initial price indication based on our existing range are free. If your project requires a new product concept or an individual solution, we agree a one-off concept and planning fee of €150 in advance as the final price. VAT is not shown separately. The scope and cost require separate approval before work begins. If you then commission us to make the same project, the fee is credited in full against that invoice. Without a production order, it pays for the agreed concept work.
Is there a minimum order quantity?
Yes. Standard products generally start at 10 pieces. For more customised projects, a sensible quantity is usually 25 pieces or more.
Can you give an exact price straight away?
The exact price depends on quantity, format, engraving and design. That is why we start with realistic price ranges.
Yes. Depending on the product, we can incorporate logos and short messages. If needed, we check legibility and appearance beforehand.
Available products may be adapted at short notice. We check the quantity, customisation and your preferred date before committing.
What would you like to create for your business? A short message is enough. We will discuss the remaining details together.
After your enquiry, we agree the details. You receive an offer with a price and timeframe. We only start work after your approval.

Your enquiry is free. We only develop new concepts after separate approval of a one-off €150 fee (final price; VAT not shown separately). If you commission production of the same project, the amount is credited in full.
An approximate range is enough. It helps us recommend products that fit your quantity and budget.
